title: A Revised Underwater Image Formation Model
authors: Akkaynak D.; Treibitz T.
key_claim: The current model descends from atmospheric dehazing equations; the revised model shows that the broadband coefficient governing backscatter differs from the coefficient governing direct transmission, although existing models treat them as identical.
limitation_vs_ours: 只给出前向方程与系数关系，不定义任何逐像素或逐分量的可恢复性度量；本文把它当作 G_psi 的物理来源，而不是竞争方法。

title: Sea-Thru: A Method for Removing Water From Underwater Images
authors: Akkaynak D.; Treibitz T.
key_claim: Uses RGBD images, the darkest pixel together with known range to compute backscatter, and a spatially varying illumination estimate to obtain distance-dependent attenuation coefficients.
limitation_vs_ours: 需要深度图（RGB-D）；本文设定是单张 RGB，因此不可直接对比，只能作为物理模型类的上界参照。

title: Underwater Color Restoration with Vanishing Uncertainty
authors: Solomatov G.; Akkaynak D.
key_claim: Color restoration is a fatally ill-posed problem in full generality and requires additional constraints to narrow the solution to a finite uncertainty interval; the paper identifies idealized conditions guaranteeing bounded uncertainty that converges to zero as camera resolution increases.
limitation_vs_ours: 给出的是解析充分条件与分辨率极限，需要已知水体光学参数与场景几何；本文给的是单张 RGB 上可计算的分量级数值量，并做恢复器耦合实验，只称操作性歧义估计。

title: Exploring and Evaluating Image Restoration Potential in Dynamic Scenes
authors: Zhang C.; Su S.; Zhu Y.; Yan Q.; Sun J.; Zhang Y.
task: predict which input is worth restoring (IRP)
method_family: deep regression on a composite-degradation dataset
key_claim: Proposes the image restoration potential concept and trains a deep model to predict which input image leads to superior restored quality, used for frame selection and as auxiliary guidance.
limitation_vs_ours: 输出是整图级标量，任务是动态场景去模糊；没有观测模型、没有 nuisance 参数、没有颜色或频率分量分解。

title: Multi-level Constrained Learning for Underwater Image Enhancement (MCL-UIE)
authors: Bao W.; Xie L.; Zhang K.; Lu H.
code_url: https://github.com/Wangtao-Bao/MCL-UIE (代码公开；权重状态未核实)
method_family: uncertainty-gated wavelet residual + monotonic chromatic transform
uncertainty_type: learned confidence gate calibrated by normalized wavelet reconstruction error
key_claim: Paired-reference supervision does not by itself specify the color mapping, the strength of local detail corrections, or consistency with the degraded observation.
limitation_vs_ours: 目前最近邻：观测一致性加不确定性门控高频残差。但其 gate 由重建误差回归校准，不由成像模型与噪声协方差导出，也不报告 nuisance 参数敏感性；本文必须正面比较这一条。

title: Uncertainty Inspired Underwater Image Enhancement (PUIE-Net)
authors: Fu Z.; Wang W.; Huang Y.; Ding X.; Ma K.-K.
key_claim: Decomposes underwater image enhancement into distribution estimation and a consensus process, so that the model can sample multiple plausible enhancements.
limitation_vs_ours: 分布由数据拟合得到，不来自成像模型的噪声与参数不确定性；没有 nuisance 参数的 Fisher/Schur 处理，也不给分量级可分辨性。

title: Bayesian Neural Networks for One-to-Many Mapping in Image Enhancement (BEM)
authors: Huang; Yang; Lin; Qi; Bull; Anantrasirichai
key_claim: A degraded image can correspond to multiple plausible targets due to dynamic photography conditions, and a BNN captures this data uncertainty to produce diverse outputs, refined by a DNN stage.
limitation_vs_ours: 处理 one-to-many 的数据不确定性，回答的是多样性而非可恢复性；不区分颜色分量与频段，也不含观测模型参数。

title: Accelerating Adaptive Diffusion and Uncertainty Modeling for Underwater Image Enhancement
authors: Zeng; Peng; Fu; Fan; Tu; Huang; Ding
key_claim: The progressive uncertainty driven high-frequency stage models the uncertainty of reference textures and combines it with feature modulation to progressively reconstruct multi-scale high-frequency structures.
limitation_vs_ours: 建模对象是参考纹理的不确定性，不是观测对目标的可支持程度；低频与高频的划分来自 Laplacian 分解而非信息量。

title: UADiff: A Deep Underwater Image Enhancement Network Using Generative Diffusion Prior and Uncertainty-Aware Learning
authors: Ou Y.; Esmaeilzehi A.; Ahmad M. O.; Swamy M. N. S.
key_claim: Various spatial regions require different restoration techniques, so uncertainty-aware learning strives to process various spatial regions of the underwater image based on their restoration uncertainty.
limitation_vs_ours: 空间分区依据是网络预测的恢复不确定性；本文的对象必须由观测模型与噪声协方差独立导出，这正是必须对照的基线。

title: Uncertainty-Guided Adverse Weather Restoration via Gated Transformer Network (UAR-Net)
authors: Jin Z.; Cui Y.; Jin T.; Knoll A.; Cao H.
key_claim: An Uncertainty-Aware Refinement Head performs artifact removal, detail enhancement and predictive uncertainty estimation, supervised by a brightness-aware energy loss to encourage well-calibrated uncertainty.
limitation_vs_ours: 非水下场景；不确定性引导门控加细节增强的组合已被占位，本文必须证明差异来自测量对象本身而非这套管线。

title: Degradation-Aware Adaptive Context Gating for Unified Image Restoration (DACG-IR)
authors: He L.; Chu J.; Lv F.; Liu W.; Li T.; Cheng J.; Fang Y.
key_claim: A lightweight multi-scale degradation-aware module extracts coarse degradation information and generates layer-wise prompts that guide attention temperature and output gating.
limitation_vs_ours: 门控来自可学习表征，没有可解释的信息量或协方差依据；若本文只做门控就与它等价。

title: Two-Stage Teacher-Student Reliable Prior Learning for Robust Underwater Image Enhancement (RPL-UIE)
authors: Chen Y.; Liu J.; Zheng Y.; Sun Z.; Chen T.
key_claim: Frequency-aware prior residual calibration retains stable low-frequency residual components and selectively modulates high-frequency detail residuals to produce calibrated priors.
limitation_vs_ours: 高频残差的选择性调制已有先例；其监督信号来自成对图像的 teacher 先验，而非观测支持度。

title: An Underwater Image Enhancement Benchmark Dataset and Beyond (Water-Net / UIEB)
authors: Li C.; Guo C.; Ren W.; Cong R.; Hou J.; Kwong S.; Tao D.
key_claim: A two-branch gated fusion network with input refinement and confidence map generation fuses white-balanced, histogram-equalized and gamma-corrected inputs.
limitation_vs_ours: 此处的 confidence map 是三种预处理结果的融合权重，与可恢复性无关；这是换名质疑最主要的对照点，必须显式区分。

title: U-Shape Transformer for Underwater Image Enhancement (LSUI)
authors: Peng L.; Zhu C.; Bian L.
key_claim: Builds the LSUI dataset of 5004 pairs and strengthens attention to more severely attenuated channels and regions via channel-wise multi-scale fusion and spatial global modelling transformers.
limitation_vs_ours: 结构与数据集贡献；不提供任何可计算的可靠性量，是实验对照的骨干而非近邻。

title: Adaptive Dual-domain Learning for Underwater Image Enhancement (SS-UIE)
authors: Peng L.; Bian L.
key_claim: Existing methods treat all regions uniformly and ignore that high-frequency detail regions are harder to reconstruct.
limitation_vs_ours: 动机与本文高度重叠（高频更难恢复），但用可学习模块隐式处理；本文需证明显式支持度带来额外且可分离的收益。

title: Phaseformer: Phase-based Attention Mechanism for Underwater Image Restoration and Beyond
authors: Khan M. R.; Negi A.; Kulkarni A.; Phutke S. S.; Vipparthi S. K.; Murala S.
key_claim: Proposes a 1.77M-parameter lightweight phase-based transformer using phase-based self-attention and an optimized phase attention block.
limitation_vs_ours: 轻量化与相位注意力的结构贡献；无不确定性、无可恢复性判据。

title: FDCE-Net: Underwater Image Enhancement With Embedding Frequency and Dual Color Encoder
authors: Cheng Z.; Fan G.; Zhou J.; Gan M.; Chen C. L. P.
key_claim: The frequency spatial network decouples degradation factors in the frequency domain and enhances each attribute separately, while a dual-colour encoder links colour and semantics.
limitation_vs_ours: 频域解耦是隐式的，不量化每个频段被观测支持的程度，也不给出可分辨上限。

title: CDF-UIE: Leveraging Cross-Domain Fusion for Underwater Image Enhancement
authors: Zhang H.; Xu H.; Yu X.; Zhang X.; Gao X.; Wu C.
key_claim: Existing methods face limitations in separating and processing frequency components and in effectively fusing domain information.
limitation_vs_ours: 跨域融合的结构贡献；不涉观测模型与不确定性。

title: Underwater Image Enhancement with Cascaded Contrastive Learning (CCL-Net)
authors: Liu Y.; Jiang Q.; Wang X.; Luo T.; Zhou J.
key_claim: Cascaded contrastive learning uses the first-stage colour-correction result as the negative sample for the second-stage dehazing network.
limitation_vs_ours: 两阶段对比学习；无不确定性建模。

title: Toward Sufficient Spatial-Frequency Interaction for Gradient-aware Underwater Image Enhancement (SFGNet)
authors: Zhao C.; Cai W.; Dong C.; Zeng Z.
code_url: https://github.com/zhihefang/SFGNet (即 ChenzhaoNju/SFGNet；代码开源；权重未查到)
key_claim: A dense Fourier fusion block and a dense spatial fusion block are combined to achieve sufficient spatial-frequency interaction for gradient-aware enhancement.
limitation_vs_ours: 梯度与频域的结构贡献；不给可恢复性度量。

title: WWE-UIE: A Wavelet & White Balance Efficient Network for Underwater Image Enhancement
authors: Cheng C.-H.; Lee J.-W.; Lee C.-M.; Hsu C.-C.
code_url: https://github.com/chingheng0808/WWE-UIE (代码与 UIEB 权重均开源)
key_claim: A gradient-aware module uses Sobel operators and learnable gating to preserve edges while a wavelet-based enhancement block performs multi-band decomposition.
limitation_vs_ours: learnable gating 无概率语义、无观测模型依据；可作为门控但非支持度的对照臂。

title: AquaClarity: Vision Transformer Enhances Underwater Image via Nonlinear Feature Fusion and Color Fidelity Improvement
authors: Chen X.; Li Z.; Zhang X.; Lei Y.; Dong Y.; Zhang X.; Pun C.-M.
code_url: https://github.com/CXH-Research/AquaClarity (代码开源；预训练权重未查到)
key_claim: A vision transformer with nonlinear feature fusion and explicit colour-fidelity improvement for underwater images.
limitation_vs_ours: 纯结构与色彩保真损失；无可恢复性概念。

title: SDUIE: Semi-Supervised Diffusion for Underwater Image Enhancement
authors: Cong X. et al.
code_url: https://github.com/Xiaofeng-life/SDUIE (仓库仅含 readme 与脚本，代码未放全；权重未查到)
key_claim: SDUIE-Quant enables continuous numerical adjustment of enhancement levels via low-rank adaptation weight merging, with a supervised synthetic branch and a self-supervised branch preserving natural underwater tones.
limitation_vs_ours: 增强强度可调不等于可靠性可测；无观测模型、无不确定性。

title: On Hallucinations in Tomographic Image Reconstruction
authors: Bhadra S.; Kelkar V. A.; Brooks F. J.; Anastasio M. A.
key_claim: Decomposes the image estimate into a generalized measurement component and a null component and introduces a hallucination map to expose where prior-driven structure appears.
limitation_vs_ours: 线性高斯层析下的正交分解；不做 nuisance 参数化、不做颜色或频率分量分解、不涉及波长相关衰减。

title: Spotting Hallucinations in Inverse Problems with Data-Driven Priors
authors: Sampson M. L.; Melchior P.
venue: ICML 2023 Workshop on ML for Astrophysics
uncertainty_type: Fisher-based, likelihood versus prior information ratio
key_claim: Computing the diagonal elements of the Fisher information matrix of the likelihood and of the data-driven prior separately flags regions where the information is prior-dominated.
limitation_vs_ours: 逐点对角、按标量参数处理，不含 nuisance 参数的 profile 或 Schur 修正，也不给分量级分解；这是对象一最直接的先例，必须引用并声明增量。

title: Inequalities and Approximations for Fisher Information in the Presence of Nuisance Parameters
authors: Clarkson E.
uncertainty_type: Fisher bounds under marginalization of nuisance parameters
key_claim: Gives inequalities and approximations for the Fisher information matrix when nuisance parameters with prior probability densities are marginalized out.
limitation_vs_ours: 纯理论、光学成像语境、无图像域实验；本文做的是 profiled/Schur 版本并落到 UIE 的分量上。

title: PHYSTAT Informal Review: Marginalizing versus Profiling of Nuisance Parameters
authors: Cousins R. D.; Wasserman L.
key_claim: In regular models with finitely many parameters and large samples the two approaches are asymptotically equivalent, but outside this setting the two methods can lead to different tests and confidence intervals.
limitation_vs_ours: 方法学综述而非图像工作，但决定了本文必须写明 psi 未知时采用 profile 还是 marginalize 及其代价。

title: Local Information Operators for Spatial Identifiability in Distributed-Parameter Inverse Problems in Computational Mechanics
authors: Bakeer T.
uncertainty_type: Fisher information / Gauss-Newton curvature / noise-weighted sensitivity Gramian
key_claim: Model discrepancy, nuisance parameters and prior information modify the same geometry through covariance inflation, Schur-complement information loss, and prior-preconditioned modes.
limitation_vs_ours: 与本文理论表述最接近的一篇，但对象是计算力学中的分布参数反演；本文的增量在图像域分量分解与恢复器耦合，不在代数本身。

title: Measurement Geometry and Design for Trustworthy Generative Inverse Problems
authors: Jin P.; Li N.; Li Q.
key_claim: Proposes a local measurement-manifold compatibility measure quantifying how well the operator observes prior-relevant tangent directions, and shows it controls the stable part of the reconstruction error.
limitation_vs_ours: 与观测支持概念同构，但目标是测量算子设计而非 UIE 恢复器；不涉及颜色或频率分量与波长相关衰减。

title: Recovery-Oriented Optical System Design Based on Fisher Information
authors: 未逐位核实
uncertainty_type: Fisher information of the restoration task
key_claim: Connects optical system design explicitly to downstream restoration performance via Fisher information, showing that an RMS-optimized lens images better directly but restores worse.
limitation_vs_ours: 证明 Fisher 信息用于恢复已有光学设计侧工作；本文的增量不在用 Fisher 信息"，而在 UIE 的分量级 profile 与经验验证。"

title: Towards Distribution-Shift Uncertainty Estimation for Inverse Problems with Generative Priors
authors: Kim M.; Fridovich-Keil S.
task: OOD and failure detection in inverse problems
key_claim: Uses reconstruction stability under random measurement perturbations as an out-of-distribution and failure indicator that needs no calibration set.
limitation_vs_ours: 稳定性是经验代理量而非 Fisher 精度；不区分分量，也不给可解释的参数敏感性。

title: Trustworthy Image Super-Resolution via Generative Pseudoinverse
authors: Floros A.; Moosavi-Dezfooli S.-M.; Dragotti P. L.
key_claim: Formalizes the notion of consistency with respect to the measurements as a necessary condition for trustworthiness and provides an asymptotically consistent algorithm.
limitation_vs_ours: 只要求结果落在观测一致集内（可行性），不量化该集合在某分量方向上的宽度（可分辨性）；对象二正是后者。

title: Looks Too Good To Be True: An Information-Theoretic Analysis of Hallucinations in Generative Restoration Models
authors: Cohen R.; Kligvasser I.; Rivlin E.; Freedman D.
uncertainty_type: inherent uncertainty of the restoration problem (task-level)
key_claim: Defines the inherent uncertainty of the restoration problem and shows that attaining perfect perceptual quality entails at least twice this uncertainty.
limitation_vs_ours: 给出任务级标量下界，不能逐像素或逐分量计算，也无法与具体恢复器耦合；只能作为下界讨论的引用。

title: Recovery Limits in Pointwise Degradation
authors: Treibitz T.; Schechner Y. Y.
task: recovery limits under scattering and attenuation
key_claim: A cutoff frequency is induced by noise despite having no optical blur, so pointwise degradation still has a resolution limit.
limitation_vs_ours: 分析性结论，需要已知退化与噪声参数，未给出可从单张 RGB 估计的数值图；其频域截止思想与对象二同源，必须作为先例引用。

title: Principal Uncertainty Quantification With Spatial Correlation for Image Restoration Problems
authors: Belhasin H.; Romano Y.; Freedman D.; Rivlin E.; Elad M.
key_claim: Constructs an ambiguity region that guarantees inclusion of true unseen values with a user-defined confidence probability by using principal directions of the empirical posterior.
limitation_vs_ours: ambiguity region 一词在图像恢复中已被占用；其后验由数据驱动，不含成像模型与 nuisance 参数，也不给分量级可分辨性。

title: Conformal Risk Control
authors: Angelopoulos A. N.; Bates S.; Fisch A.; Lei L.; Schuster M. J.
key_claim: Generalizes conformal prediction to control the expected value of any monotone loss function, with guarantees tight up to O(1/n).
limitation_vs_ours: 提供覆盖与风险保证，不解释为什么某区域不可恢复；本文只能把它当作报告 risk-coverage 曲线的工具。

title: Self-Supervised Conformal Prediction for Image Restoration
authors: Everink J.; Tamo Amougou O.; Pereyra M.
task: prediction intervals for image restoration without ground truth
key_claim: Calibrates conformal prediction intervals for image restoration without ground truth by substituting a Stein unbiased risk estimate for the missing reference.
limitation_vs_ours: 只给区间宽度与覆盖，不给可解释成因（观测模型或参数不确定性）；输出形态接近但语义不同。

title: Image Super-Resolution with Guarantees via Conformalized Generative Models
authors: Adame I.; Csillag M.; Goedert J.
key_claim: Uses conformal prediction to create a confidence mask telling users where the generated image can be trusted, applicable to any black-box generative model.
limitation_vs_ours: 后处理式覆盖保证，与物理成像模型无关；可作为换名质疑中 confidence map 一侧的最新代表。

title: Rethinking Generative Methods for Image Restoration in Physics-based Vision: A Theoretical Analysis from the Perspective of Information
authors: Kang X.; Xie H.; Wong M.-L.; Qin J.
key_claim: Identifies three information sources that determine restoration behaviour and derives the corresponding information boundaries by extending the information bottleneck principle.
limitation_vs_ours: 任务级、不可逐像素计算；只能支撑信息上限存在"的讨论，不能支撑具体测量对象。"

title: Image Reconstruction with Imperfect Forward Models and Applications in Deblurring
authors: Korolev Y.; Lellmann J.
method_family: set-theoretic / order intervals in Banach lattices
uncertainty_type: feasibility set from data and model-error bounds
key_claim: Errors in the data and in the forward models are described using order intervals, yielding a lattice-theoretic reconstruction framework demonstrated on deblurring.
limitation_vs_ours: 带噪声与模型误差的可行集"是凸集投影传统，不能当作本文的新概念；增量只能在分量分解、参数 profile 与恢复器收益检验上。"

title: Uncertainties of Optical Parameters and Their Propagations in an Analytical Ocean Color Inversion Algorithm
authors: Lee Z.-P.; Arnone R.; Hu C.; Werdell P. J.; Lubac B.
key_claim: Following the theory of error propagation, analytical functions are derived to evaluate how uncertainties of optical parameters propagate into the inherent optical properties retrieved by the quasi-analytical algorithm.
limitation_vs_ours: 对象是水体固有光学量反演而非图像增强；但它证明水下光学参数不确定性传播在海洋光学中已成熟，本文必须把主张限定在 UIE 范围内。

title: DACA-Net: A Degradation-Aware Conditional Diffusion Network for Underwater Image Enhancement
authors: Huang C. et al.
key_claim: Conditions the diffusion process on degradation-aware representations extracted from the input underwater image.
limitation_vs_ours: 退化感知条件化，不含不确定性或可恢复性度量。

title: MFP-PAINet: Enhancing Underwater Images Through Multi-Dimensional Feature Fusion and Probabilistic Uncertainty Modeling
authors: Wu S.; Xu H.; Zhou X.; Wan Z.; Zhai Z.; Wu X.
key_claim: Many deep learning methods rely on approximate reference images yet tend to neglect the inherent uncertainty of these references; a probabilistic confidence-generation module adaptively fuses multiple maps at the initial stage.
limitation_vs_ours: 建模对象是参考图标注噪声，与观测支持度无关；同时报告 LSUI 上 SSIM 0.854、PSNR 23.044、UIQM 3.056。

title: Underwater Image Enhancement Method Based on Incremental Learning and Improved Probabilistic Uncertainty Modeling
authors: Han Y.; Sun R.; Wang L.; Cai L.; Zhang S.; Geng Z.
venue: Expert Systems with Applications (in press), ScienceDirect S0957417426016301
key_claim: Combines incremental learning with an improved probabilistic uncertainty model for underwater image enhancement (title and author list verified; abstract body not retrieved).
limitation_vs_ours: 题录可核，摘要正文未取到；仅凭题名不足以判定其不确定性对象，记为尚未核实。

title: SEA-PACE: Semi-Supervised Underwater Image Enhancement via Gaussian Process-Assisted Self-Paced Learning
authors: 未逐位核实
key_claim: Uses a Gaussian process to assist self-paced curriculum selection under scarce paired data (snippet-level evidence only; AAAI OJS blocked by anti-bot).
limitation_vs_ours: 站点被反爬拦截，摘要仅从检索片段获知，需二次核实；即便成立，其不确定性作用于样本权重而非像素可恢复性。
